purpose: Teach: 盛り込ん/伺う/留保/派生/量産/保留/激減/差し上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文に、新しい視点を、盛り込んで、書け、独自性、出せ。
lines.en: Ren, work a fresh perspective into that paper when you write it. Show some originality.
lines.style: Measured, low delivery. Firm imperative landing on each clause. Demanding but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。来週、研究室を、お伺うことになっています、新教官に、ご挨拶します。
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm scheduled to visit the lab next week — I'll pay my respects to the new professor.
lines.style: Prompt, earnest reply. Slightly over-precise diction, sitting up straighter in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究テーマ、しばらく、留保して、慎重に、選び直せ。
lines.en: Hold your research topic in reserve for now. Take your time and choose again — carefully.
lines.style: Deliberate pace, each clause dropped like a stone. Quiet firmness, no rise in volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。基礎研究から、派生して、応用研究に、進めたいです。
lines.en: Yes. Branching off from the basic research, I'd like to move into applied work.
lines.style: Careful thinking-aloud pace that quickens as the idea takes hold. Quiet enthusiasm underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 量産可能な技術、社会的意義、君も、考えろ。
lines.en: Technology that can be mass-produced, and what it means for society — you need to think about those too.
lines.style: Slow, weighted emphasis on the key terms. A teacher's pause between clauses, letting each land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発表予定、しばらく、保留にしていただきました、まだ、修正中です。
lines.en: Yes. They've put my presentation on hold for the time being — I'm still making revisions.
lines.style: Slightly sheepish admission, pace dipping on the last phrase. Honest, offering no excuses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究分野、若手の参入、激減しているって、聞くな、君は、頑張れ。
lines.en: They say the number of young people entering the field has plummeted. You keep at it.
lines.style: Dry observation softening into rare, quiet encouragement on the final words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先生に、お祝いの言葉、論文発表後、差し上げたいです。
lines.en: Yes. Once the paper is presented, I'd like to offer the professor my words of congratulations.
lines.style: Bright, resolved close. A formal bow almost audible in the phrasing, earnest to the last word.
